page.overview:
Who is Jonas Carvers?

Jonas Carvers is a next generation Piston Cup racer who joins team No Stall in Cars 3.

Jonas enters the season as a mid-season replacement for the previous No Stall racer, Todd Marcus. He starts his career at the Bumper Save Gears and Glory 450, held at the Heartland Motor Speedway offscreen. In the Los Angeles 500, he is seen starting in sixteenth place next to Ryan "Inside" Laney, and finishes in 8th place. In the Florida 500, Jonas starts in thirty-second place behind Rich Mixon. When Cam Spinner causes the wreck, he is involved in the wreck. Jonas restarts and finishes in 30th place.
